- No file or documentation changes detected in this version.

Initial release of Minimax Crypto Trading Agent skill.

- Implements a multi-layered decision system for BTC/ETH/SOL trading.
- Prioritizes survival and risk management; will only output EXECUTE or NO TRADE decisions.
- Requires valid Swing Failure Pattern (SFP) for all trades; no SFP means automatic NO TRADE.
- Strict risk controls: maximum 1% per trade, forced NO TRADE on large drawdowns.
- Weekly agent review ensures high NO TRADE ratio and penalizes any non-A+ trades.
